scenarios.title: Invasion of Kazakhstan
scenarios.map: Kazakh steppe; Russian western entry, Federation eastern cities; broad tank fronts; Kazakhstan-specific borders.

scenarios.title: Invasion of Persia
scenarios.map: E.U. attack from Caucasus and western Iranian approaches; Zagros passes, plateau, Persian Gulf; reuse Iraq–Iran terrain where accurate.

scenarios.title: Battle for Xinjiang
scenarios.map: E.U. western entry from Kazakhstan; Urumqi; Tarim Basin, Tianshan and defensible but traversable passes.

scenarios.title: Invasion of India
scenarios.map: E.U. advances from Persia via northwest and can land from the Arabian Sea; dense Indian cities, real coasts/ports and multiple fronts.

scenarios.title: Invasion of Mongolia
scenarios.map: E.U. invades from Siberia into the Mongolian steppe; wide maneuver warfare and Ulaanbaatar defensive hub.

scenarios.title: Invasion of Manchuria
scenarios.map: E.U. northern and western invasion from Siberia and Mongolia into Liaoning/Jilin/Heilongjiang; rivers and industrial cities.

scenarios.title: Crossing the Himalayas
scenarios.map: E.U. advances north from conquered India into Chinese-held Tibet; deliberately passable Himalayan approaches, high attrition/defensive mountain routes.

scenarios.title: Invasion of Sichuan
scenarios.map: E.U. enters from Tibet via mountain passes; Chengdu Basin, western Sichuan relief, river and mountain defensive lines.

scenarios.title: Battle of Beijing
scenarios.map: E.U. southward offensive from Manchuria into northern China; Beijing, Tianjin and defensive river/mountain approaches.

scenarios.title: Battle of Luoyang
scenarios.map: Distinct E.U. finale; reuse existing 83-city Luoyang geography without changing battle-luoyang; north and southwest E.U. assaults against fortified Chinese capital.

integration: All 10 scenario PRs merged into architecture branch and registered in manifest/catalog generator and campaign registry. Still needs combined full-engine simulations, balance review, gameplay and visual checks before main.
mandatory: Normal/Hard/Challenge/Elite; EU vs cf faction rosters; functional industry/production; Army Groups; commanders; terrain/coasts/ports accurate; AI offense and defense; no victory timers or fake completion; independent standalone visibility after integration; elite conversion and correct reward eligibility; tests and seeded simulations for both factions with plausible winnability; data-driven meta; no sweeping shared changes.
